scenes.title: Follow the argument. Reproduce the result.
scenes.text: The first four examples have ordinary proofs and executable checks. The new quantization module adds a different kind of evidence: twenty three Lean theorem declarations, alongside twenty six existing S U seven declarations. The next chapters explain how these certificates connect to physical assumptions. A proof checks an implication. Applying it to nature also requires the right physical dictionary.

scenes.title: Where physics meets mathematics
scenes.text: A mathematical object becomes physical through a specified identification. In the interval example, an operator eigenvalue becomes a squared normal mass after fixing the length scale and kinetic normalization. A Gram matrix describes overlaps; physical families additionally require the actual field domain. Quantization works the same way. We must name the gauge group, the allowed bundles and the action before an arithmetic certificate becomes a physical constraint.

scenes.title: A periodic field must return to the same phase
scenes.text: Here is a concrete connection. In this normalized axion example, the topological action is theta times the period of Q. Shifting theta by two pi multiplies the quantum phase by the exponential of two pi i times that period. An integer period returns to the same phase. A half integer gives a minus sign. The phase diagram illustrates this consistency requirement. It is not an experimental measurement, or a complete construction of the action.

scenes.title: The global group correlates the coefficients
scenes.text: The Lie algebra alone does not fix the global gauge group. For H equal to S of U two times U three, the characteristic class dictionary combines three coefficients into alpha, beta and delta. Universal integrality requires these three combinations to be integers. Set alpha and beta to one and gamma to seven twelfths. Delta becomes zero: the total class is A plus B. Lean verifies the arithmetic criterion; the characteristic class interpretation is supplied separately.

scenes.title: Change the allowed backgrounds, change the test
scenes.text: Now take Q equal to C over two. A universal test on the projective plane detects a half integer period. On a closed smooth spin four manifold, the square of an integral degree two class has even period, by the Wu formula. The stated spin test therefore passes. These are different questions, not conflicting answers. Lean checks the coefficient arithmetic. Wu parity and the choice of physically admissible orbifold backgrounds are separate steps.

scenes.title: Two fractional contributions, one integral class
scenes.text: In the U two example, the two factor contributions have to be added. With b zero equal to one and b one equal to six, the cocharacter one, zero gives one quarter plus three quarters: exactly one. For every integer m and n the sum is m squared plus m n plus n squared. The certificate proves the joint criterion, including rational coefficients. This establishes an integral characteristic class, not an anomaly free supergravity spectrum with those coefficients.

scenes.title: A conserved linear combination detects an obstruction
scenes.text: A proposed parent response must lie in the image of its allowed transfer map. Both displayed columns are annihilated by ell, so every response in that image has ell equal to zero. For the required response, six ell equals sixteen minus three p minus three q minus six r. It is one modulo three for all integers. This rules out matching within that response family. Extra corner terms, a different spectrum or a different global construction would require a new analysis.

scenes.title: An involution on one field is not a full group lift
scenes.text: The degree eighteen Clifford element t a squares to minus one. Multiplying by minus i produces U a, whose square is plus one on the representation. Both identities are correct, but they answer different questions. A physical symmetry must act consistently on all fields and interactions, including the bosonic Omega field. A twisted or combined action may be possible. The exact lift audit does not prove inconsistency, and it is not a Lean formalization.

scenes.title: From a theorem to a control and an exact figure
scenes.text: The module is the interface to these scoped statements. Each control changes the exact rational inputs. The criterion and its witness determine the displayed lattice and cocharacter map. A finite figure illustrates the result; the Lean proof supplies the universal arithmetic statement. Four Lean files contain forty nine theorem declarations in total. The complete download includes all eighty maintained data files. Integrity hashes, numerical checks and formal proofs certify different things.

scenes.title: Where measured data enter the chain
scenes.text: These plotted values come from the published ATLAS top pair and CMS dijet searches already used by the laboratory. They are observed upper limits under different resonance assumptions, not measured new particle production rates. Neither search reports a significant new particle signal. To test our quantization examples, we still need a physical map to masses, couplings, widths and predicted rates, with uncertainties. Data can support that physical realization. They cannot replace its mathematical proof, and remaining below a limit is not a discovery.
